title: How a Godly Man Takes Correction From Someone Younger Than Him
caption:
Somebody younger tells you you're wrong, and the first move is defense. You're building the case for why you're right before he's even finished the sentence.

Paul told a church not to look down on Timothy for being young, then let God use him anyway. Truth doesn't wait around for seniority to notice it.

Sit with what he said before you decide how you feel about how he said it. Most correction dies in the tone. Don't let it die there.

Who's the last person younger than you that you actually let correct you? Save this for the next time it happens.

#faith #humility #godlyman #christianmen #teachablespirit
